content:
Soon-to-be-former Rep. Lauren Boebert’s (R-Colo.) farewell post backfired.

The controversial far-right congresswoman shared a lengthy video message on X after conceding to Democratic rival Eileen Laubacher, as Democrats took back control of both the House and the Senate in the 2026 midterms in what has widely been interpreted as a blistering rebuke of Donald Trump.

One commenter posted a photo of himself posing with Boebert while holding a sign that read, “Can’t buy KY.”

Boebert responded: “Unfortunately, we were all wrong, races can be baught.”

The spelling of “bought” as “baught” and the doubling down on her campaign’s apparent suggestion of election skulduggery, prompted mockery online:
